title: GET CONTAINER SET(ptr) FLENGTH(len): FLENGTH is output only, the SET ADDRESS OF view covers the container's data, a repeated GET SET and a GET SET after a replacing PUT; CONTAINERERR RESP2 10 and CHANNELERR RESP2 2

scenarios.summary: CAGCST PUTs a 20-byte BIT container, GETs it with SET and FLENGTH (preset 99, comes back 20), views it, GETs SET again, PUTs 8 bytes over it and GETs SET once more (FLENGTH 8); no pointer from before the PUT is read
CAGCSX GETs SET a container that does not exist (CONTAINERERR RESP2 10) and from a channel that does not exist (CHANNELERR RESP2 2), then the real container (FLENGTH 20)
